notes.title: Friday Update #3
notes.notes:
This update was a long time coming, finally implemented the ability to customize note colors!

Future plans include delay offsetting, custom highway images, custom backgrounds, and a song editor.

In other news, I recently received a promotion at my full time job giving my more responsibility. This will definitely effect my ability to work on games for a while. I'll keep you updated on future plans and dates as I sort that out.

As always, thanks for playing!

- Stephen

notes.title: Friday Update #2
notes.notes:
A new song joins the list!

Please welcome IDFK and their bubbly track Heartful.

Looking forward to adding more of their unique tracks into the game.

notes.title: Friday Update #1
notes.notes:
I'm a little light on the update this week. I wasn't able ton finish the song charts on time due to final exams and projects. I hope you can forgive me, I promise when the semester ends I'll be more regular on the updates!

This update is still important, it adds the ability to rebind controls; something requested by almost every positive and negative review.

It also adds some small optimizations throughout.

Expect some more requested features to come soon! Let me know about any bugs.

Thanks for playing, as always,

-Stephen
